entries.question: I have been diagnosed with allergic rhinitis with Ige level 1023 which department should I look up to in kgmu
entries.answer:
For allergic rhinitis and to understand your high IgE levels, you should consult the **Department of Respiratory Medicine** or the **Department of Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy** at KGMU.

You can find more information about these departments here:

*   **Respiratory Medicine:** [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=27&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=27&dept_type=2)
*   **Dermatology, Venereology & Leprosy:** [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=12&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=12&dept_type=2)

entries.question: नहीं मेरा एडमिट और ऑपरेशन रिकॉर्ड चाहिए
entries.answer:
Main samajh sakta hoon ki aapko apna admit aur operation record chahiye. KGMU AI CHATBOT hone ke naate, main website par uplabdh jankari tak pahunchne mein aapki madad kar sakta hoon.

KGMU ki website par sidhe treatment record ya operation record download karne ka koi seedha link uplabdh nahi hai. Aise records prapt karne ke liye, aapko KGMU ke **Medical Superintendent Office** se sampark karna hoga.

Yahan kuch jankari di gayi hai jo aapke liye upyogi ho sakti hai:

*   **Medical Superintendent Office Contact:**
    *   **Shah Mina Rd, Chowk, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226003**
    *   **Phone Number:** 0522-2258880 (Help Line) ya 0522-2257540 (VC Office, jahan se aap MS office ke bare mein pooch sakte hain)

Aapko unse milkar ya phone karke apne admit aur operation record ke liye anurodh karna hoga. Ve aapko sahi prakriya batayenge ki yeh records kaise prapt kiye ja sakte hain.

entries.question: opd appointment kaise le
entries.answer:
OPD appointment lene ke liye, aap nimn tareekon ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1.  **Online Registration:** Sabse pehle, aapko www.ors.gov.in par online registration karna hoga.
2.  **Phone Call:** Aap 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call karke appointment book kar sakte hain.
3.  **SMS:** Aap "APPOINTMENT <Your Name>" likhkar 8887019134 par SMS bhi bhej sakte hain.

Appointment ke samay, kripya apne appointment ki printed copy ya SMS saath layein. OPD ka samay subah 9:00 AM se dopahar 2:00 PM tak hai.

entries.answer:

entries.answer:
